templates.name: AI coding agents by HTTP
templates.description: Claude Code and Codex usage (tokens, cost, sessions, timings) from the homestack AI Usage service, which reads the agents' OpenTelemetry metrics from Prometheus.

items.name: AI Usage snapshot (1h)
items.description: Dashboard data of the last 1h; every other item depends on it.

triggers.name: AI Usage API: no data for 30 minutes (1h)

items.name: Claude Code: API request duration, avg (1h)
Claude Code: API request time to first token, avg (1h)
Codex: turn time to first token, avg (1h)
Codex: turn time to first output, avg (1h)

triggers.name: AI Usage API: no data for 30 minutes (24h)

items.name: All agents: cost (24h)

triggers.name: AI agents cost over {$AI.COST.24H.WARN} USD in the last 24h

macros.description: Base URL of the AI Usage (hs-usage) service, set it on the host.
Poll interval; the service caches its Prometheus reads.
Addresses allowed to push history into the per-day items (backfill).
